title: Validate sales and purchase return units against live product before reversing inventory
description: Enable the same shared unit guard for manual and linked sales/purchase returns. Shared converter currently only recognizes PackageUnit conversion; arbitrary nonempty units pass unchanged for both return-detail overloads and new manual numeric/master validation503 does not establish product unit membership. Reject before draft numbering/tracked mutation, revalidate effective stored base-unit eligibility at operational posting under current return/source locks, preserving explicit StockOut/StockIn ancestry and existing gross return capacity. Unit validation must not introduce automatic refunds/credits/cost revaluation or infer source rows. Existing shared ReturnDocumentDraftRules is declared in SalesReturnSourceRules.cs; reuse it and the existing PurchaseReturnSourceRules.cs, no new alternate return business paths. Preserve current identity/menu/customer scope, live product/warehouse/supplier validation, source ownership/capacity locks and atomic posting/reversal. No new grants, schema/migration, database, automatic source links or historical unit rewrite. Only explicitly supplied nonempty unsupported units are rejected; preserve established empty-unit/base-unit fallback after checking existing code/tests, or fail controlled if no base unit exists rather than inventing a new unit. Case-insensitive trimmed comparisons use current semantics. Package conversion applies exactly once using current positive UnitsPerPackage, keeps authoritative base quantity and existing rounding policy; downstream storage bounds and overflow guards remain. No conversion/inference between arbitrary units. No new historical read/cancel/unaudit gate. Adapt original unit/SQL fixtures genuinely without deleting assertions. Unique unused per-invocation logs/TRX under .ai/logs/<task>; preserve full original failures. Genuine SQL uses fresh GUID NEWERP_AUTOTEST only, no drop/reset/reuse/production. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized manual and linked draft writes reject explicitly supplied units outside the referenced live product base/package units before number reservation, tracked header/detail replacement or any persistence. Preserve existing supported blank-unit fallback and valid base/package inputs, repeated product rows and optional source semantics; invalid/missing base/package configuration yields controlled error without guessing.

Operational submit/approve revalidate effective stored unit/master/source eligibility in existing document/source locks. Package quantity is normalized exactly once and not reconverted on commitment; existing base-unit source capacity, monetary quantities, current precision/overflow guards and inventory ledger remain coherent. Rejection changes no document/status/source capacity/numbers/stock/movements; historical undo/read semantics remain.

Meaningful unit/controller and genuine isolated SQL cover unlinked and linked drafts, arbitrary nonempty unit, whitespace/case/base/package inputs, blank fallback, invalid/mutated base or package master, conversion factors/overflow, cumulative source capacity after conversion and no double conversion. Run related original fulfillment/posting/source/cancellation/concurrency SQL regressions plus safe Release/full units, preserving original failures and exact environment evidence.
implementation_evidence: StockUnitConversion.SalesReturnDetail and PurchaseReturnDetail overloads share package-only private logic:50-51, allowing arbitrary nonempty manual unit. Return draft validation503 handles product/numeric integrity, while357/358 link capacity checks apply to explicit sources; no complete manual-unit guard. Source/history/docs search found no return unit-membership task.
